name: Muhammadiyah Sapen Universal School (MSUS)
address: Jl. Brawijaya, Gatak, Tamantirto, Kasihan, Bantul

notes.id: Pengembangan sekolah Rp18.000.000. Biaya bulanan termasuk snack dan makan siang. Total biaya awal Rp31.340.000 (putra) / Rp31.490.000 (putri). Dibuka Juli 2026; Kurikulum Nasional + pengayaan Cambridge dan pendekatan IB.
notes.en: School development fee Rp18,000,000. Monthly fee includes snacks and lunch. Initial total Rp31,340,000 (boys) / Rp31,490,000 (girls). Opened July 2026; national curriculum with Cambridge enrichment and an IB approach.

source.title: Biaya SD Muhammadiyah Sapen dan MSUS 2027/2028, Segini Bedanya! (IDN Times Jogja)

steps.id: Daftar/inden melalui aplikasi Super Sapen sesuai jadwal
steps.en: Register/pre-book through the Super Sapen app on schedule

notes.id: Peminat sangat tinggi; antrean inden disebut sudah sampai tahun ajaran 2033.
notes.en: Very high demand; the pre-booking queue reportedly reaches the 2033 intake.

source.title: Biaya SD Muhammadiyah Sapen dan MSUS 2027/2028, Segini Bedanya! (IDN Times Jogja)
